The political parties called for selection of beneficiaries of Indiramma Houses under through Gram Sabhas | Photo Credit: BY ARRANGEMENT
Leaders and cadres of four Left parties and the Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) staged a dharna in Khammam on Thursday, demanding transparency in the selection of beneficiaries and allotment of houses under the Indiramma housing scheme.
The protesters called for the selection of beneficiaries under the second phase of the scheme through Gram Sabhas in Gram Panchayats.
They also demanded the abolition of Indiramma committees, alleging political bias in the selection process.
They further demanded that houses be allotted to all eligible poor families and that pending bills for incomplete houses sanctioned under the Indira Awaas Yojana and other previous housing schemes be released immediately.
Several senior leaders of the CPI, CPI (M), CPI (ML) Mass Line, CPI (ML) Praja Pandha, and BRS participated in the protest.
